# About Me


![](IMG_6760.jpg){width=300px}

My name is Charlie Jacobs and I am a junior at Case Western Reserve University pursuing a B.S. in Biochemistry with a concentration in Computational Health Sciences,
interested in both computational and wet-lab roles in pharmaceutical research and development. I am currently completing
graduate-level coursework in preparation for applying to the Combined Master’s in Biotechnology program with a concentration
in Pharmacology, with an interest in interdisciplinary translational research spanning computational biology, molecular biology, and drug
development.

:::
